name: Kimi CLI
description: Kimi CLI by MoonshotAI - a CLI AI coding agent with a web terminal via ttyd.

notes.text: Access Kimi CLI in your browser at http://<container-ip>. The first run launches the login/setup wizard.
Config and session data is stored in ~/.kimi/.
Browser access uses ttyd, which has no authentication by default. Restrict port 80 with a reverse proxy or firewall before exposing it publicly.
